title: Rainforest falling whistle
role: A separate isolated short descending rainforest bird whistle
prompt: TrackType: SFX, A single shy tropical forest bird makes one brief soft descending sweet chirp, a clear airy twee whistle that bends down and stops. A natural short bird call in the middle register around 1500 to 2200 Hz, lightly woody but clearly whistled, never low or throaty. Only one half-second bird phrase with silence before and after. No continuous song, no repeated chirping, no cooing, hooting, mammals, ape voice, owl, pigeon, human voice, insects, weather, music or instruments. Length: 5 seconds.
backend: Official MLX local inference on Apple Silicon
processing: Official pipeline output preserved as stereo44100Hz32-bit float WAV without clipping or normalization. No reverb, compression, mixing or post-effects added. Browser copy normalized separately.
listeningReview: Technical validity checked. Perceptual prompt adherence requires audition.
